notes.title: "Best gameplay" Nominee and "Best Kept Secrets" Award!
notes.notes:
Hello dear adventurers,

We’re here today to celebrate the Silver Aggie Award for “Best Kept Secrets” achieved by Beyond the Sky!

Beyond the Sky also received an Aggie Awards nomination for "Best Gameplay", and we’re very happy for this too! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3gAiYTu.png[/img]

Beyond the Sky is our very first title and we're so honored and grateful for this amazing award and for the kind words that the Staff of Adventure Gamers wrote about:

"With such a long history of point-and-click adventures, it’s always enjoyable to find one that plays with the formula, does new things, and yet still feels familiar and comforting. Iperurania Arts’ Beyond the Sky delivers just such an experience, though you wouldn’t know it at a glance. Between progressively unlocking new abilities for its young, naïve protagonist Selene, and presenting a number of challenging logic statement puzzles (and then offering necessary support in solving them), this is a surprisingly rich gameplay experience that becomes increasingly delightful throughout. Add in a lovely paper cutout visual style and storybook-style prose, and the only thing preventing this charming tale from a happily-ever-after ending is enough of an audience to enjoy it."

[url=https://adventuregamers.com/articles/view/36893/page14]https://adventuregamers.com/articles/view/36893/page14[/url]

Thank you all for support and for playing Beyond the Sky!

We think that the best way to celebrate this good news is with a week-long SALE! :D

We wish you a great week ;)
Giulia, Federico and Jones the cat!

notes.title: Great news! New language and hint system added!
notes.notes:
Hello dear adventurers,

Today we’re here with many awesome news about Beyond the Sky!

[list]
[*]You can now ask if you’re on the right way with major puzzles to relative characters;
[*]Russian language added;
[*]Fixed minor bugs;
[/list]

If you’re stuck with a puzzle, you can now ask to some character if you’re on the right track! 😉

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33708244/58bdba27f5a0dc4584d33a759770db3a8e23a96a.jpg[/img]

We’re very happy to say Привет to our dear Russian players! Now you can play Beyond the Sky also in Russian! Enjoy it!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33708244/9237641ac047ba2cc137e98bd313249d4e38ca95.jpg[/img]

[h1]VERY IMPORTANT NOTE[/h1]

If the game runs too slow on your pc, please scale the resolution down! You can play Beyond the Sky also at 4k resolution, but please note that the game was originally drawn at 1920x1080! if you have any problems with Beyond the Sky, please contact us at support@iperuraniaarts.com. We’ll do our best to help you!

Have a great day and enjoy Beyond the Sky, 
Best wishes,

Giulia and Federico

notes.title: Release date and new demo!
notes.notes:
Hello dear players, we’re excited for our first update, especially because it’s a very special one!  

First of all, we want to tell you that Beyond the Sky finally has a release date: [b]November 15! [/b] 
As you can see the date is really near and we can’t wait to let you escort Selene in the magic dark woods! 

 
We also released a new demo, with a new amazing soundtrack and graphics!  
Both the new demo and the full game are for Windows and for macOS in English, German and Italian! 

Visit our web site [url=http://www.iperuraniaarts.com/] http://www.iperuraniaarts.com [/url]  

We hope you’ll enjoy it! 

For this update it’s all, see you in our next one!  
Ciao!
